text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > tmp/notif-content-2371/final-facts.md <<'EOF'
Repository Equicom-Crypto/backoffice-core, PR target native-v1.
Implementation commit d7c1460ccd2ba62d5f2c5cc5f4a092d8051635c2, tree3350fca2a45d2e8d8a6134d2e56ffc3ba559dbbd, base1e64d818023dbec7ed5a2519fb8be4998797400c.
Problem: retried notifications with recipients already written could resolve a changed/deleted template and reject instead of completing event/provider delivery. Late timed-out USER PutItem and partial GLOBAL fanout are both affected.
Changes: immutable Aurora notification_contents store with UUIDv5 command identity, strict field/identity decoder, insert-if-absent/readback within caller's transaction and bounded retention. Worker reads frozen content before template resolution and deeplink validation. First-write attempt freezes in own transaction under existing shared command advisory lock, checks stored ingress rejection, commits before any DynamoDB write. One mutable per-attempt prepared holder lets concurrent winner content/category/priority/timestamps/channels replace stale resolved values across USER, explicit/paged fanout and park replay. Runtime switches still filter frozen channels. Rejection path rechecks content inside decision lock after stored-recipient consistent read; NOTIFICATION_CONTENT_FROZEN propagates transient, no re-entry. CONTENT_RECORD_MALFORMED per-record for USER/park, service-wide GLOBAL via existing classifier. Runtime builder/readiness require content store. Replay deletes up to1000 rows older30days excluding any PARKED notification; warning isolated from cycle completion in empty context.
Baseline db/migrations/0001_backoffice_baseline.sql already has exact table at base. No DDL edits, no new migration. requirements.py adds table,columns,jsonb type. No custom jsonb per-table masking list found in owning repo. No environment/config changes or writes. README notification section documents store, retries, retention, corrupt-row escalation. Hosted PostgreSQL CI job includes new tests.
17 files,1141 additions61deletions (1202total), onePR because storage+ordering+replay behavior atomic. Later message_key/message_params fields explicitly deferred to3084/PR505 by9Nov scope note. Existing pg_outbox payloads, IDs, recovery scopes and decision locks unchanged; deterministic malformed/unknown-category/missing-account treatment preserved; DynamoDB item shape, EdgeAPI and ws-gateway unchanged.
Validation completed: uv run ruff check . passed; uv run ruff format --check .3896files passed; selected pyright zero errors after final test typing fixes. Remote PostgreSQL16: timeout600 bash tmp/content-test.sh passed37cases. Existing notifications suite passed1208,34skipped (skips are new PostgreSQL cases run separately). New tests had37 because6lazy cases,1global,2late-write,2park,3race,21fault,1budget,1retention. Eight logical test functions plus parameterized existing runtime readiness test. Full make check currently running; do not claim pass yet. Hosted CI not started.
Fail-on-base: same tests, current stores/harness, processing.py from base1e64d818: GLOBAL partial fanout retry and USER timeout keep-content both fail on behavior (template deletion produces rejection; cannot commit); missing-content control passes. Test command CONTENT_BASE_PROOF=1 timeout600 bash tmp/content-test.sh runs those3cases, outcome2failed1passed. With head processing all37pass.
TDD mappings in tests/worker/notifications/test_content_postgres.py:
NOTIF-072 test_freeze_is_lazy_and_first_concurrent_content_wins (disabled,inactive,missing,empty,stored ingress rejection, concurrent resolved variants; separate-context committed-row read before PutItem)
NOTIF-073 test_global_partial_fanout_reuses_frozen_content_after_template_deletion (frozen metadata/runtime channel filtering; no template load; B event)
NOTIF-074 test_timed_out_put_lands_after_retry_read_without_template_rejection (keep-content,no-content control)
NOTIF-075 test_parked_frozen_recipient_uses_content_but_missing_account_still_rejects
NOTIF-076 test_content_faults_hold_without_rejection_or_template_resolution (read,freeze,unknown_commit,identity,fields,channels,boolean; USER/GLOBAL/park), test_malformed_user_exhausts_budget_while_global_retry_age_rises
NOTIF-077 test_content_retention_preserves_parks_and_cleanup_failure_completes_iteration
NOTIF-078 test_rejection_rechecks_content_under_postgres_decision_lock (ingress,park,busy).
Contract cites: Backoffice Core Lifecycle1.4,8.2items8-10,8.3,8.6item3; DataModels1.1.59,1.2.1; Events1.7; notifications_pipeline_degraded4.5step8,4.6step6; TDD NOTIF-072..078. No Broker link outward.
Sibling sweep: ingress USER and explicit GLOBAL use prepared holder; paged GLOBAL routes same holder; unstored parked recipient same prep/write; stored-recipient resume continues reading DynamoDB; malformed/unknown-category before content stay unchanged; content outbox+retry share exact runtime transport; park row replay already empty Context and retention gets own Context; runtime builder/modes/readiness connected; existing rejection publisher unchanged. Skills/watchers/wiki search no conflicting content-store-specific rule; scope exception message fields documented.
Failure/input matrix: read/freeze dependency errors service-wide before PutItem; unknowncommit no write on same attempt and retry reads durable row; overlapping try-lock busy no rows; freeze-before-rejection transient; malformed identity/missing field/empty channels/bool integer rejects stored-data decode and never resolves; null optional values accepted; malformed USER budget parks and GLOBAL retryage holds; failedcleanup warns/completes.
Quint internal evidence: /Volumes/ExternalSSD/crpko-devops/tmp/quint/2371/content.qnt, updated park-rejection overlap included. quint run --invariant safe --max-steps40 --max-samples10000 passed; JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk quint verify --invariant safe --max-steps7 --server-endpoint localhost:9171 passed. Safety checks pending/stored hasfreeze, ingressrejection no pending/stored, firstcontentwins, disjointstored/rejectedrecipient. No bug caught by model; actual tests caught cleanup missing log argument and preserved rejection exception behavior.
Linear identifier: none supplied on this design task. Do not invent an id. CRP-14469 is downstream message-key work, not this change.
EOF","max_output_tokens":1000}));
